source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: زمان، قبل ما يصير في تلفونات، الناس كانت تبعت رسائل.
sentences.en: Long ago, before there were phones, people used to send letters.

sentences.ar: خالي سافر برا البلد يشتغل ويجمع مصاري.
sentences.en: My uncle traveled abroad to work and save money.

sentences.ar: كل شهر، كان يبعت رسالة لإمه، جدتي.
sentences.en: Every month, he would send a letter to his mother, my grandmother.

sentences.ar: جدتي ما كانت تعرف تقرا، فكانت تجيبني أقرالها.
sentences.en: My grandmother didn't know how to read, so she would bring me to read to her.

sentences.ar: كنت أقعد جنبها وأقرا الرسالة بصوت عالي.
sentences.en: I would sit next to her and read the letter out loud.

sentences.ar: كانت تسمع وعيونها تدمع من الشوق.
sentences.en: She would listen and her eyes would water from longing.

sentences.ar: بعدين، كانت تملي عليي الرد، وأنا أكتب.
sentences.en: Then, she would dictate the reply to me, and I would write.
Once, my uncle's letter was two months late.

sentences.ar: جدتي قلقت كتير وما عادت تنام.
sentences.en: My grandmother worried a lot and stopped sleeping.

sentences.ar: كل يوم، كانت تسأل: وصلت رسالة؟
sentences.en: Every day, she would ask: did a letter arrive?

sentences.ar: وأنا أرد: لسا يا جدتي، بكرا إن شاء الله.
sentences.en: And I would answer: not yet, grandma, tomorrow, God willing.

sentences.ar: بالآخر، إجت الرسالة، وكان خالي مريض بس طاب.
sentences.en: Finally, the letter came, and my uncle had been sick but recovered.

sentences.ar: جدتي بكت من الفرح وحضنت الرسالة.
sentences.en: My grandmother cried from joy and hugged the letter.

sentences.ar: قالت: الحمد لله اللي رجعلي خبر منه.
sentences.en: She said: thank God that news of him came back to me.

sentences.ar: لهلأ، بحتفظ بهديك الرسائل بصندوق قديم.
sentences.en: To this day, I keep those letters in an old box.

sentences.ar: كل ما أقراها، بتذكر جدتي وشوقها.
sentences.en: Every time I read them, I remember my grandmother and her longing.
